page_title: TOU 2-2 CLE | Toulouse v Clermont 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Florent Ogier (Clermont) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:2.
90+5' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Decent spell from Clermont here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The referee blows his whistle, Clermont are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+1' Yellow card! It's like Mory Diaw (Clermont) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Florent Batta agrees and books him.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' A player from Clermont commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
88' Florent Batta blows his whistle and signals a foul after Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) brought his opponent down.
86' Florent Batta blows his whistle after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
85' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
84' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Zakaria Aboukhlal and he is replaced by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
83' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Florent Batta interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse).

80' Wasted effort! Muhammed Cham (Clermont) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
76' A substitution has been made. Grejohn Kyei goes off and Komnen Andric (Clermont) comes on.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) will replace Bilal Boutobba.
75' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Maxime Gonalons will be replaced by Yohan Magnin (Clermont).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Denis Genreau (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch so that Frank Magri can be given a rest.
73' A cooling break is underway.
73' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
72' The Toulouse players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
71' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
69' Neto Borges (Clermont) sends a cross into the box, but Guillaume Restes comes off his line to gather the ball.
68' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Clermont move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. Corner kick. Clermont will have an opportunity.
66' Clermont fail to score from a corner as Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) leaps to collect the ball.

65' The Clermont players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. The ball is out of play. Clermont will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' Substitution. Jim Allevinah (Clermont) has come on for Mehdi Zeffane.

62' That's unlucky! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) picks up the ball within his own half and goes on a mazy run before shooting from distance. The ball looks in all the way but curls at the last second and flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
59' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) replacing Cristian Casseres.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Cesar Gelabert Pina cannot continue after picking up an injury.

55' Corner kick falls to Bilal Boutobba (Clermont), who attempts to trick the keeper. Luck is not with him today, his fine strike only rattles the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
55' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Clermont.
55' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
52' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
51' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) brings his opponent down. Florent Batta has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Neto Borges (Clermont) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
50' Toulouse are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
48' A player from Toulouse pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
47' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Clermont.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Florent Batta blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Clermont as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
45+5' There's a break in play and referee Florent Batta must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Clermont using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+4' Poor challenge! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is penalised for tripping and Florent Batta blows his whistle.
45+2' Neto Borges (Clermont) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Guillaume Restes.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Clermont keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
40' Florent Ogier (Clermont) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
34' 2 - 1 Goal! Guillaume Restes gets a hand on the penalty from Grejohn Kyei (Clermont), but can't stop it from flying into the top left corner.
34' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
33' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Clermont!
33' It’s a PENALTY to Clermont after the VAR review!

32' Play continues despite the shouts by some Clermont players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Florent Batta interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

31' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
30' Clermont hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Clermont have a corner.
24' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
23' Neto Borges (Clermont) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
23' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) makes a slide tackle, but referee Florent Batta blows for a foul.
22' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
21' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Clermont get a corner.
21' Some patient build-up play from Clermont as they look to unlock the defence.

19' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
15' Florent Batta sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
15' The Toulouse players halt their celebrations as referee Florent Batta makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
14' 2 - 0 An excellent first touch by Frank Magri (Toulouse), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
12' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Neat passing move from Clermont in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
6' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) after he collected a pass and unleashed his shot. He attempted to surprise the goalkeeper, who easily stopped his shot.
4' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) passes the ball onto Frank Magri, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Florent Batta will referee today's match.
